content.short: Unifold provides cross-chain deposit infrastructure for prediction markets, exchanges and fintechs.
content.description: Unifold builds the deposit layer for platforms where funding friction directly costs revenue, such as prediction markets and exchanges, with a cross-chain payment SDK spanning major networks. Monad's documentation lists it among onramps. Prediction markets have been a notable driver here, since their users arrive with funds on whatever chain they already use.
